meta.name: ai-avatar-video
meta.description: Create AI avatar and talking head videos with OmniHuman, Fabric, PixVerse via inference.sh CLI. Models: OmniHuman 1.5, OmniHuman 1.0, Fabric 1.0, PixVerse Lipsync. Capabilities: audio-driven avatars, lipsync videos, talking head generation, virtual presenters. Use for: AI presenters, explainer videos, virtual influencers, dubbing, marketing videos. Triggers: ai avatar, talking head, lipsync, avatar video, virtual presenter, ai spokesperson, audio driven video, heygen alternative, synthesia alternative, talking avatar, lip sync, video avatar, ai presenter, digital human

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI生成说话的数字人视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速生成AI数字人口播视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate talking-head videos with AI avatars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create realistic AI presenter videos quickly

howto.what: 装上后,Claude能通过 inference.sh 的命令行工具调用 OmniHuman、Fabric、PixVerse 等模型,用一张照片加一段音频生成AI数字人说话视频;支持口型同步、虚拟主持人,还能组合文字转语音完成配音。
howto.when: 当你说出“ai avatar”、“talking head”、“lipsync”等关键词,或要求生成AI数字人说话视频时触发。

say.text: 用这张照片和这段音频,生成一个数字人说话视频。
把这段中文语音和这张人像照片做成口型同步视频。
帮我给这段英文视频配音成中文,再做口型对齐。
say.note: 会走转写-翻译-语音合成-口型同步流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the inference.sh CLI to run models like OmniHuman, Fabric, and PixVerse, turning a portrait photo and an audio clip into an AI avatar talking-head video, with lipsync and virtual presenter support, and can combine TTS and STT for dubbing workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords such as "ai avatar", "talking head", "lipsync", or asks for an AI digital human speaking video.

say_en.text: Generate a talking-head video from this photo and this audio.
say_en.note: Runs an OmniHuman model to synthesize the video.

say_en.text: Make a lipsync video from this portrait and this Chinese speech.
Dub this English video into Chinese and sync the lips.
